title: Leading AI Startup SparkCognition Rebrands as Avathon and Aims to Triple Workforce in India Within 24 Months
ai_summary: Avathon, formerly SparkCognition, announced its rebranding and plans to triple its India workforce within 24 months. The company aims to apply AI to legacy infrastructure in energy, aviation, and supply chain, with over $100 trillion of aging infrastructure facing strain. India will serve as a hub for product engineering, delivery, support, and R&D.
